title: Saudi-Style Toasted Vegetable Delight
description: A delicious and easy-to-make dish that combines the flavors of Saudi Arabia with the simplicity of toasted vegetables.

ingredients.name: arabian vegetable
ingredients.notes: such as bell peppers, zucchini, and eggplant

instructions: Slice the Arabian vegetable into 1-inch pieces.
Place the slices on a baking sheet and drizzle with kissed olive oil.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Bake in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
Meanwhile, toast the juicy bread slices.
Once the vegetables are done, assemble the snack by placing the toasted bread slices on a plate and topping with the roasted vegetables.
